name: i-love-meow
description: I Love Meow — a real, running social platform for cat lovers. Persistence uses the `sqlite3` package (stable, ships prebuilt binaries — no node:sqlite, no native build tools required on Railway/Docker/Linux). The optional dependencies below power production infrastructure (Redis-backed rate limiting/caching, Prometheus metrics, Sentry error tracking) and are only imported if installed and configured via env vars — the app runs fine without any of them.
